last.verdict: Alani Nu's boom drove a revenue beat, but flagship CELSIUS keeps shrinking, margins slipped further, and Q4 growth is guided lower.

takeaways.label: Alani Nu carries growth
takeaways.text: Alani Nu revenue rose 24% to $410M and its retail sales jumped 58%, while flagship CELSIUS fell 6% to $357M. Total revenue of $847M beat the roughly $800M expected.

takeaways.label: Margins still shrinking
takeaways.text: Gross margin was 46.8% versus 51.3% a year ago, hurt by aluminum, diesel and a shift to PepsiCo distribution. Management guides the full year to the high 40s; the low 50s will take longer.

takeaways.label: Q4 growth slows
takeaways.text: The CFO said Q4 revenue growth will be below the first three quarters. About $20-25M of Q4 shipments were pulled into Q3, and last year's inventory benefit won't repeat.

takeaways.label: CELSIUS fix pushed to 2027
takeaways.text: New brand-led structure with a new CELSIUS president. Management admits the brand isn't 'where we want it to be'; new products were delayed, with innovation returning in 2027.

history.verdict: Big revenue and profit miss, with the flagship CELSIUS brand shrinking again.

reasons.label: Flagship brand shrinking
reasons.text: CELSIUS brand sales fell about 12%; management admitted cutting too many products.

reasons.label: Missed estimates
reasons.text: Revenue of $818M trailed the roughly $870M expected; adjusted EPS $0.36 vs $0.42.

reasons.label: Margins stay squeezed
reasons.text: Gross margin was 48.1% vs 51.5% a year ago; aluminum costs and promotions weighed.
